*** Add File: oauth_callback.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
+
+
+def exchange_authorization_code(code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"]
+    client_secret = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET"]
+    payload = {
+        "code": code,
+        "client_id": client_id,
+        "client_secret": client_secret,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT, data=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def handle_callback(query_params: Dict[str, str], redirect_uri: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if "error" in query_params:
+        raise ValueError(query_params["error"])
+    code = query_params.get("code")
+    if not code:
+        raise ValueError("Missing authorization code")
+    return exchange_authorization_code(code, redirect_uri)
*** End Patch

"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: start_oauth_login.py
+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/callback")
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.getenv("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
+AUTH0_SCOPE = os.getenv("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+
+
+def main():
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN:
+        raise SystemExit("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
+    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise SystemExit("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
+
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+        "scope": AUTH0_SCOPE,
+        "state": state,
+    }
+    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
+        params["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE
+
+    authorization_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
+    print(authorization_url)
+    webbrowser.open(authorization_url)
+
+    requests.get("https://{}/.well-known/openid-configuration".format(AUTH0_DOMAIN), timeout=10)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
